question: Teejan Bai is associated with which of the following dances?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Pandvani**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Pandvani** is a traditional folk dance drama that narrates tales from the Indian epic **Mahabharata**.
 
• This art form is performed in the Indian state of **Chhattisgarh**.
